title: The Gilded Charter of Castle Daggerfall
summary: Unravel a conspiracy between cliffside privateers, rebel barons, and an ancient Vraseth bloodline mentor beneath Castle Daggerfall before the Betony garrison mutinies.

npcs.name: Envoy Genevieve Montrose
npcs.greet: Hold, traveller! Have you come up the bluff road or across the Ilessan boundary? The Crown's charter chests were seized before dawn.
talk: Three baronial toll-collectors were found drained of blood beside the harbour chain, and the Knights of the Dragon are blaming the Owl's clerks.
If the Betony garrison isn't paid by moonrise, the cliff captains will sell the sea-gate keys to the privateers in Thorncliff Caverns.

npcs.name: Sir Baptiste of the Owl
npcs.greet: Speak softly. Half the Dragon's lancers in this courtyard take coin from Woodborne's cousins.
talk: The stolen chest didn't just hold silver—it held the red-wax Betony muster rolls and an older parchment sealed with the Vraseth crest.
Trace the harbour smugglers through Ilessan Hills to Thorncliff Caverns before the tide floods the sea-vault.

npcs.name: Sister Maelle of the Bluff
npcs.greet: Kynareth's wind carries salt and old iron today. You hunt the men who broke the harbour chain?
talk: They rode past Linwold Monument with muffled hooves, bearing lanterns of blue tallow that only burn in the old baronial crypts.
Take this storm-blessed oil; the things waking beneath Loroylle and Woodborne Hall do not fear ordinary steel.

npcs.name: Captain Vauquelin
npcs.greet: Put up your blade! My company was locked out of the inner keep when Lord Amaury opened the lower cistern.
talk: Amaury swore the Vraseth court-mentor would restore the pre-Warp baronies if we surrendered the Betony seal.
Break the ward in the undercroft and we will hold the gate against his privateers!

story_df_archon_amaury_vraseth.name: Lord Amaury of the Vraseth Charter

story_df_harbour_chain: Envoy Genevieve Montrose: Look at the links of the harbour chain—sheared clean through with alchemical frost from a Tristore flask.
Sir Baptiste of the Owl: And see the wax crumb left on the bollard? Crimson boar-tallow, stamped with an unmerged baronial signet.
Envoy Genevieve Montrose: Then the privateers at Thorncliff are only the oarsmen. Someone inside the peerage is steering the hull.
story_df_thorncliff_parley: Bosun Kerguelen: You're late, Owl-dog! The charter chest has already gone up the ridge toward Woodborne Hall and Loroylle!
Sir Baptiste of the Owl: And the three toll-clerks drained white on the quay—was that part of your freight, pirate?
Bosun Kerguelen: That was the passenger's tithe. Draw your iron if you want to ask him yourself!
story_df_vraseth_sanctum: Lord Amaury: For three hundred years the Vraseth elders kept the true rolls of the bay while Castle Daggerfall fattened on toll-silver!
Sir Baptiste of the Owl: You sold the Betony watchtowers to throat-slitters and blood-drinkers for a dead title, Amaury!
Lord Amaury: Titles only die when no hand dares sign them in blood. Come—witness the old peerage!

quests.title: The Broken Harbour Chain
quests.summary: Inspect the severed harbour chain at Daggerfall with Envoy Genevieve and report the baronial conspiracy to Sir Baptiste at Castle Daggerfall.
intro: Before dawn, smugglers sheared the great harbour chain of Daggerfall and carried off the Betony garrison's pay-chest and muster rolls.
Examine the crime scene with Envoy Genevieve and bring your findings to Sir Baptiste of the Order of the Owl at Castle Daggerfall.
complete: Sir Baptiste recognized the alchemical frost residue and the pre-Warp baronial wax immediately: a faction of disgruntled bluff barons has allied with cliff privateers.

journal.start: Envoy Genevieve Montrose asked me to inspect the severed harbour chain in Daggerfall and consult Sir Baptiste at Castle Daggerfall.
journal.done: We confirmed that the stolen Betony charter chest was taken by privateers working for a rebel baron.

Examine the severed chain with Envoy Genevieve
Report to Sir Baptiste at Castle Daggerfall

quests.title: Lanterns on the Sea-Bluff
quests.summary: Track the smugglers' pack-train past Linwold Monument to Ilessan Hills and take Sister Maelle's storm-blessed oil.
intro: The thieves avoided the Dragon knights' turnpikes by cutting across the shepherd ridges between Linwold Monument and Ilessan Hills.
Search the monument stones for their drop-marks and speak with Sister Maelle in Ilessan Hills.
complete: Sister Maelle confirmed that blue graveyard lanterns were carried toward Thorncliff Caverns on the coast.

journal.start: I must follow the smugglers' trail to Linwold Monument and speak with Sister Maelle at Ilessan Hills.
journal.done: Sister Maelle gave me storm-blessed oil and pointed me toward the privateer anchorage in Thorncliff Caverns.

quests.title: The Salt-Hound's Anchorage
quests.summary: Storm Thorncliff Caverns, defeat Bosun Kerguelen, and recover the Betony garrison pay-chest.
intro: Bosun Kerguelen's sea-rovers use the flooded limestone arches of Thorncliff Caverns to unload contraband beneath the bluff.
Enter Thorncliff Caverns, confront Kerguelen, and find where the Vraseth charter was taken.
complete: Bosun Kerguelen fell in the sea-cave, revealing that Lord Amaury carried the Vraseth blood-charter up to Woodborne Hall and the crypts of Loroylle.

journal.start: I must enter Thorncliff Caverns and defeat Bosun Kerguelen to recover the stolen chests.
journal.done: I recovered the garrison silver from Thorncliff Caverns and learned that Lord Amaury took the charter to Woodborne Hall and Loroylle.

quests.title: Blood on the Red Wax
quests.summary: Rally Captain Vauquelin at Woodborne Hall, descend into Loroylle, and destroy Lord Amaury of the Vraseth Charter.
intro: Lord Amaury has sealed himself inside the ancient vaults of Loroylle beyond Woodborne Hall to awaken a Vraseth blood-scryer and forge a new feudal covenant.
Coordinate with Captain Vauquelin at Woodborne Hall, breach Loroylle, and end Amaury's rebellion.
complete: With Lord Amaury defeated and the Betony muster rolls returned to Castle Daggerfall, the Knights of the Owl and Dragon have renewed the harbour watch.

journal.start: I must meet Captain Vauquelin at Woodborne Hall, then enter Loroylle and defeat Lord Amaury.
journal.done: I slew Lord Amaury in Loroylle and returned the sealed charter to Envoy Genevieve in Daggerfall.
